Haryana to Develop 5 New Cities Along KMP Expressway

Haryana plans to develop five new cities along the Kundli-Manesar-Palwal (KMP) Expressway, with development modeled on Singapore. The state's Industry and Commerce Minister, Rao Narbir Singh, stated that the industry department's budget for 2026-27 will increase from ₹1,327.76 crore to ₹1,950.92 crore to expand industrial infrastructure and foster investment. The KMP Expressway, approximately 135 kilometers long, is seen as crucial for realizing the 'Developed India-2047' vision and will shape the National Capital Region's identity.
